verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for an API-driven payments platform like Stripe Connect, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes API versioning or a deprecation policy. The llms.txt note about checking npm for the latest package version concerns SDK package versions, not versioned APIs or deprecation terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
